title: Browser QA Agent
description: A guarded local browser team that inspects one approved website, captures visible evidence, and reports usability and runtime failures without signing in or changing data.
audience: Product teams that want repeatable browser checks without a hosted browser bill
goal: Produce a local screenshot and structured QA report for one explicitly approved website.

triggers.name: Local CLI
triggers.description: A human supplies the target URL and approved host boundary.

tools.name: Local Playwright
tools.description: Open an isolated, unsigned browser context and capture visible evidence.

agents.name: Boundary Guard
agents.role: Validates the target, request method, and network boundary.
agents.escalationPolicy: Stop when the URL or network boundary is unsafe.

agents.name: Page Observer
agents.role: Loads the approved page and captures bounded visible evidence.
agents.escalationPolicy: Stop on redirect, timeout, or blocked-host ambiguity.

agents.name: QA Verifier
agents.role: Turns observations into a local review report.
agents.escalationPolicy: Leave interpretation to a human when visible evidence is ambiguous.

steps.title: Approve browser boundary
steps.action: Validate the URL, allowed hosts, protocol, and network destinations.

steps.title: Capture page evidence
steps.action: Open the approved page, block writes, and capture one stable viewport plus runtime signals.
steps.onSuccess: Pass evidence to deterministic QA checks.

steps.title: Write QA report
steps.action: Write bounded JSON and Markdown artifacts without sending page content to a model or service.

modelRoutes.reason: The public runner does not require an AI key.

guardrails.title: Public network only
guardrails.policy: Private, loopback, link-local, and unapproved hosts are blocked unless the human explicitly enables local fixture testing.

guardrails.title: Read-only requests
guardrails.policy: POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, and other state-changing browser requests are blocked.

guardrails.title: Ephemeral session
guardrails.policy: The runner does not load a user profile, cookies, extensions, or saved credentials.

evaluations.title: Host containment
evaluations.metric: Requests remain inside the approved host set

evaluations.title: Evidence completeness
evaluations.metric: Successful audits include JSON, Markdown, and a screenshot
